user.title: Connect to your Kuvasz Uptime instance

data_description.name: A name for this instance. It becomes the title of the integration entry and must be unique.
data_description.host: The base URL of your Kuvasz instance, including the scheme and port.
data_description.api_key: The API key configured on your Kuvasz instance. Leave it empty if your instance does not require one.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off if your instance uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll your Kuvasz instance, between 10 and 3600 seconds.
data_description.stats_period: The time window used for the uptime ratio and the average sensors.
